question: What youthful form results from constant yogic practice over time?
premises: A specific duration is implied by two times eight years
The practitioner attains a corresponding youthful form
inference: Through constant yogic practice, one may attain the form of a sixteen-year-old.
uncertainties: dvi-aṣṭa-varṣa-ākṛtiḥ interpreted as the form of sixteen years
plain_english: Through constant yogic practice, one may attain the form of a sixteen-year-old.
